Hi Tara / Biomedix procurement team,

Attached is a redline of the Order Form (Biomedix_OrderForm_v2_redline.docx) that aligns to the MSA we discussed last week. High level:
- Added a two-tier signature matrix (POs <$50k: procurement sign-off; POs >=$50k: legal + exec sign-off).
- Clarified PO acceptance window (48 hours) and electronic acceptance via Ariba/Coupa as valid acceptance methods.
- Specified invoice remit and GL code fields we require to map for automated reconciliation.

Two asks so we can sequence enrollment:
1) Will Biomedix enroll via Ariba or Coupa for vendor provisioning? If Ariba, do you have an administrator we should coordinate with?
2) Can you confirm the required vendor taxonomy / GL code field names (we included our recommended field mapping in the redline).

If you prefer, we can run a 30-minute call to walk through the redline and the Ariba registration checklist — Marissa and Karthik will join to cover legal and integration gating.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Proposal: Order form signature matrix + Ariba enrollment sequencing for Biomedix

Tara — thanks for the quick reply and for looping in Anil. Short responses from legal/ops below.

1) Signature matrix: we can accommodate a single-exec signatory up to $150k provided Biomedix confirms internal delegation of authority and supplies a short delegation memo (one page). I'll leave the exact threshold in the order form redline as a variable ("$THRESHOLD") and we can replace it when you confirm.

2) GL code vs free-text remit: We strongly prefer a structured GL code field to support automated PO->invoice reconciliation. If you can put the 6-digit GL as a mandatory field in Ariba, we can map it to our invoice ingestion. If not, we can accept free-text as a stopgap but it will add manual steps and delay automated matching by 1–2 billing cycles.

3) PO acceptance / electronic acceptance: legal is comfortable with Ariba electronic acceptance as long as the order acknowledgement timestamp maps to the PO acceptance clause — I added language to the redline to make this explicit (see para 3b of the attached notes).

Next steps proposed:
- Priyom to introduce Anil Rao to our onboarding engineer (Karthik) for Ariba field mapping and test credentials.
- Biomedix to confirm final signature threshold and share delegation memo by Thu COB (9 Apr).
- We aim to lock the order form by Fri EOD (10 Apr) to allow Ariba provisioning the following week.

I attached a short notes PDF with the legal clarifications and the suggested signature matrix layout (signature_matrix_notes.pdf). If that timeline works, we'll update the redline and circulate a final clean copy for signature.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
